components.name: FloatingChat
components.description: The chat as a whole: the round button, the window and the list of messages.

props.name: header
props.description: The header the chat shows. Left out, the chat has none.

props.name: greeting
props.description: The greeting the chat opens with. Left out, it opens empty.

props.name: composer
props.description: The composer the guest writes in. Left out, the guest cannot write.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: The colour of the button, the header and the guest's messages.

props.name: screen_side
props.description: The side of the screen the chat sits on.

props.name: contact
props.description: The contact line the chat shows. Left out, it has none.

props.name: branding
props.description: The branding line the chat shows. Left out, it has none.

props.name: messages
props.description: How the messages look. Left out, the defaults apply.

props.name: launcher
props.description: The round button the chat opens from. Left out, the chat has none.

components.name: Launcher
components.description: The round button the chat opens from.

props.name: icon
props.description: The picture on the button.

props.name: has_greeting_preview
props.description: Whether the greeting shows above the button before the chat is opened.

components.name: Header
components.description: The bar at the top of the window, with a title and a line under it.

props.name: titles
props.description: The title.

props.name: subtitles
props.description: The line under the title.

components.name: Greeting
components.description: The first message, shown before the guest writes.

props.name: greetings
props.description: What the first message says.

components.name: Messages
components.description: How the list of messages looks.

props.name: assistant_bubble_color
props.description: The background of the assistant's messages.

props.name: guest_bubble_color
props.description: The background of the guest's messages. Without one, the accent colour.

props.name: has_avatars
props.description: Whether the assistant's picture stands beside its messages.

props.name: has_feedback
props.description: Whether thumbs up and down stand under the assistant's replies.

props.name: has_timestamps
props.description: Whether the time stands under the last message.

components.name: Composer
components.description: The field the guest writes in, with the send button.

props.name: input_placeholders
props.description: The hint in the empty field.

components.name: Contact
components.description: The line under the composer with the phone, the e-mail and the contact form.

props.name: phone
props.description: The phone number the line shows. Left out, the assistant's own.

props.name: email
props.description: The e-mail address the line shows. Left out, the assistant's own.

props.name: form
props.description: The contact form the guest can open. Left out, the line has none.

props.name: copy_hints
props.description: What the phone and the e-mail say on hover.

props.name: copied_notes
props.description: What they say once copied.

props.name: copy_failed_notes
props.description: What they say when copying fails.

components.name: ContactForm
components.description: The form a guest sends a message with, opened from the contact line.

props.name: titles
props.description: The heading of the contact form.

props.name: first_name
props.description: The field for the guest's first name. Left out, the form has none.

props.name: last_name
props.description: The field for the guest's last name. Left out, the form has none.

props.name: email
props.description: The field for the guest's e-mail address. Left out, the form has none.

props.name: message
props.description: The field for the message. Left out, the form has none.

props.name: send_labels
props.description: The word beside the send button.

props.name: sending_labels
props.description: The word beside the send button while the form is sent.

props.name: discard_labels
props.description: The word beside the button that closes the form.

props.name: confirmations

default.en: Thank you for your message! Please expect our reply within 1 working day.

props.description: What the form says once it is sent.

components.name: FormField
components.description: One field of the contact form.

props.name: labels
props.description: What the empty field says. Left out, the field's own name.

props.name: is_required
props.description: Whether the form is sent only when the field is filled.

components.name: Branding
components.description: The "Powered by" line at the bottom.

props.name: texts
props.description: The words before the name.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the line ends with.

props.name: link_url
props.description: Where the name leads.
